amended_return.rationale: AmendedReturnInd directly corresponds to the amended return checkbox at the top of Form 940.

type_of_return_successor_employer.rationale: SuccessorEmployerInd matches the checkbox indicating the filer is a successor employer.

type_of_return_no_payments.rationale: NoPaymentsToEmployeesInd matches the checkbox indicating no wages were paid during the year.

type_of_return_final.rationale: FutureFilingNotRequiredInd corresponds to the final return checkbox indicating the employer stopped paying wages.

only_one_state.rationale: No candidate represents a single-state checkbox indicator; the MultiStateInd is the inverse concept and does not match Part 1 line 1a directly.

only_one_state_code.rationale: FUTAStateCd matches the two-letter state abbreviation entered on Part 1 line 1a for the single state where FUTA wages were paid.

paid_wages_multistate.rationale: MultiStateInd corresponds to the Part 1 line 1b checkbox indicating wages were paid in more than one state.

paid_wages_credit_reduction_state.rationale: CreditReductionStateInd matches the Part 1 line 2 checkbox for wages paid in a credit reduction state.

total_payments_all_employees.rationale: WagesAmt corresponds to Part 2 line 3 — total payments made to all employees before any exclusions.

payments_exempt_from_futa.rationale: TotalExemptWagesAmt matches the Part 2 line 4 total of all exempt payments.

payments_exempt_fringe_benefits.rationale: FringeBenefitsInd is the closest candidate for Part 2 line 4a fringe benefit exempt payments, though it appears to be an indicator rather than an amount — no amount element exists for this sub-line.

payments_exempt_group_term_life.rationale: GroupTermLifeInsuranceInd corresponds to Part 2 line 4b exempt payments for group-term life insurance.

payments_exempt_retirement_pension.rationale: RetirementPensionInd corresponds to Part 2 line 4c exempt payments for retirement and pension plans.

payments_exempt_dependent_care.rationale: DependentCareInd corresponds to Part 2 line 4d exempt payments for dependent care.

payments_exempt_other.rationale: OtherInd corresponds to Part 2 line 4e other exempt payments.

total_payments_over_7000.rationale: WagesOverLimitAmt matches Part 2 line 5 — total payments in excess of the $7,000 FUTA wage base per employee.

subtotal.rationale: ExemptWagesAmt is the best available candidate for Part 2 line 6 subtotal (lines 4+5), though it may represent only the exempt portion; no dedicated subtotal element exists in the candidate list.

total_taxable_futa_wages.rationale: TotalTaxableWagesAmt directly matches Part 2 line 7 — total taxable FUTA wages.

futa_tax_before_adjustments.rationale: FUTATaxBeforeAdjustmentAmt directly matches Part 2 line 8 — FUTA tax before adjustments.

if_all_futa_wages_excluded_from_state.rationale: FUTAAdjustmentAmt is the closest candidate for Part 3 line 9/10 adjustments, but the schema does not distinguish between lines 9 and 10 in the candidate list; this field is mapped with medium confidence.

if_some_futa_wages_excluded_from_state.rationale: No separate candidate exists for Part 3 line 10 (partial exclusion adjustment); FUTAAdjustmentAmt was already mapped to line 9 and cannot serve double duty — schema likely bundles both into one element, so blueprint should reconcile.

credit_reduction_amount.rationale: TotalCreditReductionAmt matches Part 3 line 11 — credit reduction amount from Schedule A.

total_futa_tax_after_adjustments.rationale: FUTATaxAfterAdjustmentAmt directly matches Part 3 line 12 — total FUTA tax after all adjustments.

futa_tax_deposited_for_year.rationale: TotalTaxDepositAmt matches Part 4 line 13 — total FUTA tax deposited for the year.

balance_due.rationale: BalanceDueAmt directly matches Part 4 line 14 — balance due when tax exceeds deposits.

overpayment.rationale: OverpaidAmt under OverpaymentGrp matches Part 4 line 15 — overpayment amount.

overpayment_disposition.rationale: Blueprint bundles the disposition choice into a single category field, but the canonical schema splits it into two boolean indicators (ApplyOverpaymentNextReturnInd and RefundOverpaymentInd); blueprint should be refactored into two separate boolean fields.

q1_futa_liability.rationale: FirstQuarterTaxLiabilityAmt matches Part 5 line 16a — Q1 FUTA tax liability.
